title: Combined exponent bound
statement: Let $\omega$ be a positive rational number and let $k$ be a natural number, and set $c=\lceil \omega k/(\omega+1)\rceil$. Then $\max\{\omega(k-c),c\}<\frac{\omega}{\omega+1}k+1$.
